name: connect-buffer
description: Connects Claude to your Buffer account with your own API key, so approved posts can be placed as drafts or scheduled on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X and more. Companion to the Content Studio plugin.

api_key.title: Buffer API key
api_key.description: In Buffer open your account settings, then API, and create a personal API key (the account owner can do this). Paste it here. It is kept in your computer's secure storage and sent only to Buffer.
